frozen_source_partition_rule.month_label_interpretation: A MEXC bulk monthly label YYYY-MM is treated as the calendar month in UTC+08:00 for corpus-integrity auditing.
frozen_source_partition_rule.partition_start_utc_rule: UTC calendar month start minus 8 hours
frozen_source_partition_rule.partition_next_start_utc_rule: next UTC calendar month start minus 8 hours
frozen_source_partition_rule.expected_rows_rule: calendar days in labeled UTC+08:00 month multiplied by 96

allowed_future_resolution_types: formally redefine Discovery boundaries to the audited vendor-partition window before any P00 execution
or establish a separately authorized boundary-extraction method that preserves the 2025 validation lock
forbidden: opening a 2025-labeled file under current authority
using another exchange to rescue missing boundary candles
silently dropping or adding boundary candles
running P00 before boundary reconciliation is frozen

final_rule: The observed UTC+08:00 MEXC bulk-month partition is authoritative for offline corpus-integrity auditing only. It does not alter the frozen P00 Discovery UTC window, unlock 2025 or 2026, authorize P00, or permit cross-exchange rescue/interpolation.
